title: Core: immutable AcceptanceEvaluation, acceptance-evaluation policy, and completion enforcement
outcome: Engram stores immutable per-criterion acceptance evaluations bound to the exact criteria, run, evaluated cut and evidence, validates verdict bases against cited objects, enforces the per-project policy and task mode at completion with typed refusal causes, and binds the passing evaluation into the completion seal; the default policy leaves existing behavior unchanged.
acceptance: Fixture tests trace to every row of the documented boundary matrix: port-PR build pass and fail via fixture verification evidence, non-build judgment criterion, missing evidence, stale after checkpoint and after criteria revision, evaluator failure leaves no record and completion refuses, mode and basis violations refuse the evaluate write, same key with a different payload refuses
Under the default policy every existing completion test passes unchanged and receipts label the path as self-asserted
cargo fmt --check, cargo check, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings and scripts/test-rust pass
